target_api.name: ForecastRuntimeConfig
target_api.signature: ForecastRuntimeConfig(batch_size: int = 64, num_workers: int = 0, device: str | None = None, pin_memory: bool = True, persistent_workers: bool = True, prefetch_factor: int = 2)

target_api.name: ForecastRequest
target_api.signature: ForecastRequest(checkpoint_path: str | Path, expected_model_key: str | None, data: DataRequest, series_ids: Sequence[str] | None, forecast_origin: date | datetime | int, runtime: ForecastRuntimeConfig = <factory>, unknown_series_policy: Literal['error', 'ignore'] = 'error')

target_api.name: ForecastResult
target_api.signature: ForecastResult(predictions: pl.DataFrame, model_key: str, forecast_origin: int)

forecast_result.point_only_models: q10, q50, and q90 remain present and null
forecast_result.quantile_point_fallback: q50 is point when no separate point output exists

temporal_semantics.lookback: The L canonical periods immediately before forecast_origin, ordered oldest to newest
temporal_semantics.iso_week_53: Accepted only when valid in the ISO week-year
temporal_semantics.timezone: Preserve an aware datetime's represented timezone when deriving its calendar period; do not first convert to UTC

series_policy.none: Select all available series in canonical string order
series_policy.unknown_ignore: Ignore unknown IDs only when explicitly requested; raise when no known IDs remain
series_policy.result_order: Resolved series ordinal then zero-based horizon_step
series_policy.batch_stability: Row identity and order are independent of batch_size

compatibility_guarantees: fill_missing keeps its existing ffill default
zero filling is available only when explicitly requested
the capitalized MultiPartExoDataModule import path may remain as a thin compatibility wrapper
forecast_to_parquet may remain as a compatibility adapter
non_goals: Consumer checkpoint or data path discovery
Parquet naming, partitioning, writing, or retention policy
DSI-specific public names including KH, oper_part_no, and part_ids
Exposing concrete DataModule or Dataset classes on the stable public surfaces
seal_algorithm: SHA-256 of sorted compact ASCII canonical JSON after removing only the top-level contract_sha256 field
